newsitem.title: TAIWAN: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - October 15.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - October 15.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Taiwan press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
CHINA TIMES - Court detains Pingtung county mayor Wu Tze-yuan for allegedly receiving T$6 million in kickbacks from construction project.
Parliament resumes screening of fourth nuclear power plant.
UNITED DAILY NEWS - Taiwan National Assembly member Chen Chi-san loses seat because of vote-buying in election.
COMMERCIAL TIMES - Many listed companies suspected of using fake invoices.
Anti-nuclear activists surround parliament in protest.
ECONOMIC DAILY NEWS - Winbond expected to lose about T$100 million from fire that hit its new wafer plant.
Wall Street cracks 6,000-point barrier in mid-session.
